'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Chris Schoenthal LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Earther Deck
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
